resources.string: Choose what happens when power returns
Boot quietly and stay asleep. Wake with the remote.
Start normally. The box may turn on the TV over HDMI-CEC.
When power returns, Android boots quietly into sleep. Press Power on the remote to wake the box.
When power returns, the box starts normally and may turn on the connected TV.
Saving a mode does not restart the box. It applies at the next cold start.
Changes are disabled: a complete, unambiguous cold_boot dispatcher and compatible native quiescent branch could not be recognized. Nothing was overwritten.
After power returns, Android will boot into sleep without its usual TV activation. You can wake the box with the remote. The box will not restart now.
Use the normal cold-start branch while preserving the rest of this device’s boot script. The box may turn on the TV after power returns. It will not restart now.
Do not disconnect power if this happened while saving. Keep the box running and check the details below before trying again.

Automatically checks the device’s boot script using the vendor SystemControl service, without a firmware-number allowlist or root. Saves the actual current script before each write and verifies the result. No network or background service. Quiet start boots Android into sleep; the processor still starts. Uninstalling does not undo the selected mode. After an OTA the new script is checked again.
This firmware has not been physically tested by this project. Its script structure was recognized. Check power-loss and remote wake behavior after saving.
